title: FoliaAutoMessage
description: folia AutoMessage plugin (chat, actionbar, titles + JSON / MiniMessage support)
body:
**foliaAutoMessage**
folia AutoMessage plugin (chat, actionbar, titles + JSON / MiniMessage support)

- chat messages
- actionbar
- titles

support JSON formatting
support of placeholders: %player%, %online%, %max_players%, %world%

_(this is my first plugin, built mainly for myself to learn java and secondary serve as a minecraft solution. code was written with some help of AI, so dont judge. if this project will turn out to be usefull, i will further update and improve it without ai)_
